response.original_title: The Dusty the Cowboy Variety Hour!
response.overview: "The Dusty the Cowboy Variety Hour!" is a character-driven feature film that centers around the titular Dusty as he uses the final episode of his ill-fated talk show to settle petty grudges and go out with a bang. The Variety Hour is a unique feature film, specifically because of how the story is presented. Instead of cutting backstage or flashing back, the entire story of the Dusty the Cowboy Variety Hour takes place within the fictional talk show and it's commercials.
